notes:
Browse Home with horizontal video shelves, or switch to Feeds for individual feeds and their video grid. Moving Up or Down in the left navigation switches sections immediately; Right enters the content.

Settings includes feed management with inline visibility switches, update checks and paired Family access. Hidden feeds stay in the list so you can restore them in place.

The logo now uses RSS arcs and a circular e inside the green play mark. Sources & notes is a quiet text action, with header space kept clear of thumbnails. Feed names are shorter while full attribution remains in details.

Existing subscriptions, saved selection, playback handlers and Family pairing are preserved. Home shelves preview 20 videos; View all opens complete individual feeds or the newest 500 combined videos.
